item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Additional Notes: SCP-073 was found in the New York Police Department in 19██, having been taken in after subject had been found amidst the bodies of several violent gang members. SCP-073 told police members that the gang had attempted to make sport of it, but became angry and attempted to kill SCP-073, resulting in their own demise. SCP-073 was incarcerated, and was deemed a "John Doe" when NYPD could not find any information on it. SCP-073 came to the attention of the Foundation through a routine inspection of "John Does", and was subsequently released into our custody.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I’m glad that this tale exists, giving us some more information about 005s acquisition (though, doesn’t that mean it came from nowhere, existing as a time artifact? Or am I confused?). That said, the bit about racist civvies is one I have a problem with. Not because of the subject matter, (though their insults do feel a bit cartoonish to me. Maybe I just don’t know enough about 1960s america?) but because Cain shows up. Why does Cain show up? That is a dangerous anomaly, capable of causing incredible damage to the ecosystem. Why did the foundation use him!? He’s so conspicuous with his forehead mark and cyborg limbs! Another GOI could have kidnapped him! Did they not have an agent they could send instead?!
Also, no one noticing the falling person from the sky, him surviving a fall from several hundred metres into water when 100 would be almost certainly lethal, and a few others really ruin this one for me.
-1
